{{Quote|You want me to fly with your forces against Cartann.''"<br />"''No. To lead them. All of them.|Wedge Antilles to Perator Escalion|<ref name="X-Wing: SOA" />}}
'''Escalion''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Adumari]] and the [[perator]] of the [[Yedagon Confederacy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]]. He provided sanctuary to [[Red Flight]], [[Iella Wessiri Antilles|Iella Wessiri]], [[Cheriss ke Hanadi]] and [[Hallis Saper]], who at the time were fleeing from the nation of [[Cartann]].

Escalion offered [[General/Legends|General]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] command of the united forces of all nations opposed to Cartann, an offer Antilles accepted. After emerging victorious from the [[Adumari Civil War]], Escalion and the rulers of the other nations formed the [[Adumari Union]].
